parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production initializer in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). Lifting the shared 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.init' into a common location would couple production DebugPanel semantics to a demonstration/sample-app fixture, which is the canonical restraint pattern. The duplication is expected: the sample app independently replicates a display-link async iterator for self-contained demonstration purposes.
